title: Sports Scandals That Shocked the World
shared_passage: Watch a video about famous cheating scandals in sports, and for questions 1 to 6, choose the correct option.

questions.question: American runner Fred Lorz...
options: drove his own car instead of running.
was helped to cheat in the marathon.

questions.question: The Chicago White Sox team...
options: was earlier called the Black Sox.
had players who had to retire from the sport.

questions.question: Maradona...
options: gave the famous name to his illegal goal.
scored another illegal goal during the same World Cup.
never totally admitted what he did.

questions.question: Nancy Kerrigan...
options: cheated to be at the Winter Olympics.
got hit in her knee while skating.
reached success after a difficult situation.

questions.question: What is true about Spain's Paralympic basketball team?
options: A person lied to them to expose the truth.
One of its players told the truth.
None of the players had disabilities.

questions.question: Lance Armstrong...
options: used drugs to compete in 1999, 2005, and 2012.
lost most of his Tour de France titles.
told the truth in front of the cameras.
